page.title: Phone numbers
page.description: The numbers your AI answers on — bought here or brought over your own trunk.

sipGate.title: Connect a SIP trunk first
sipGate.description: SIP numbers ride on your own trunk. Connect one, then register the numbers it carries.

agentSlot.noneEligible: {slot, select, inbound {No synced inbound agents yet — you can assign one later.} other {No synced outbound agents yet — you can assign one later.}}

empty.title: Get your first phone number
empty.description: Buy a number for your AI to answer, or bring your own over a SIP trunk.

numbers.allReleased: All your numbers have been released.

release.title: Release {number}?
release.descriptionSip: This unregisters the number from your trunk immediately. You can register it again later.
release.descriptionPlatform: This permanently gives the number up. Callers who dial it won't reach you, and you may not be able to get it back.

buy.title: Buy a number
buy.pickDescription: Pick an Australian local number for your AI to answer.
buy.detailsDescription: Confirm the details for your new number.
buy.searchHint: Start with an area code to match from the beginning, e.g. 02 for Sydney or 03 for Melbourne.
buy.taken: That number was just taken — pick another.
buy.agentsHint: You can assign or change agents any time after purchase.

form.inboundOnly: SIP numbers are inbound-only — outbound calls always go out from a platform number.

addSip.description: Register a number your trunk already carries, and calls to it will reach your AI.
addSip.phoneHint: The number your trunk already carries — include the area code.

setup.title: Bring your own SIP trunk
setup.description: Keep your existing numbers and carrier — route their calls to your AI.
setup.stepCredentials: We create digest credentials for you on our shared SIP domain.
setup.stepPointTrunk: Point a trunk on your PBX or carrier at your destination URI.
setup.stepRegister: Register the numbers that trunk carries and route each to an agent.

sip.activeDescription: Your PBX authenticates against our shared SIP domain with these details.
sip.releaseFirst: {count, plural, one {Release your # SIP number before disconnecting.} other {Release your # SIP numbers before disconnecting.}}
sip.disconnectedDescription: Reconnecting issues fresh credentials — your old password will not come back.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate the SIP password?
rotateDialog.description: The current password stops working immediately — update your PBX with the new one straight away.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect SIP trunk?
disconnectDialog.description: Your trunk credentials stop working immediately. You can reconnect later — you'll get fresh credentials.

sipFields.destinationHint: Replace {placeholder} with each number you register.

credentials.description: Point a trunk on your PBX or carrier at these details.
credentials.warning: Save these now — the password is shown only once and can't be retrieved later.
credentials.closeDescription: You won't be able to see this password again.
